{{Current events|year=2019|month=01|day=13|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The Syrian government and pro-government militants fire artillery into villages inside the [[Idlib]] de-escalation zone, killing one civilian and leaving two civilians injured. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/1-civilian-killed-in-regime-attacks-in-syria-s-idlib/1363693 (AA)]

;Arts and culture
*[[List of newspapers in the United Kingdom|British]] newspaper ''[[The Guardian]]'' switches from  [[Polyethylene|polythene]] wrappers to [[compost|compostable]] material made from [[potato starch]] based on customer feedback. The paper said this packaging, which is [[biodegradable]] but cannot be recycled, increases operating costs. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-46849937 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*An [[avalanche]] near the [[Austria]]n [[Lech (Vorarlberg)|Lech am Arlberg]] ski resort kills three skiers and leaves a fourth missing. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/three-skiers-killed-austrian-avalanche-fourth-missing-n958121 (NBC News)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46854663 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*A man stabs the [[List of mayors of Gdańsk|Mayor of Gdańsk]], [[Paweł Adamowicz]], on stage at a [[Great Orchestra of Christmas Charity]] event in [[Gdańsk]], [[Poland]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jan/13/gdansk-mayor-stabbed-on-stage-during-charity-event-in-poland (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Italians|Italian]] [[far-left terrorist]] [[Cesare Battisti (born 1954)|Cesare Battisti]] is extradited to [[Italy]] after his capture in [[Bolivia]]. Battisti was convicted of multiple murders nearly three decades ago. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-01-14/cesare-battisti-arrested-in-bolivia-after-37-years/10712402 (ABC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Macedonia naming dispute]]
**[[Alexis Tsipras]], leader of [[SYRIZA]] in [[Greece]], announces a vote of confidence in his government after [[Panos Kammenos]], leader of the [[Independent Greeks]] (ANEL), announces that it will withdraw from the ruling coalition due to opposition to the [[Prespa agreement]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/fdeb6d6a-1723-11e9-b93e-f4351a53f1c3 (FT)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**The [[President of Venezuela|President]] of the [[National Assembly of Venezuela]], [[Juan Guaidó]], is briefly detained in [[Caracas]] after saying he was prepared to assume the country's presidency. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-46857643 (BBC)]
